cohort_note: BEATMAPPED-ENRICHMENT-PILOT-01: a bounded, five-artist proof of the canonical Artist entity (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and its genre enrichment — not a claim of complete artist coverage. Every entry here is linked (see artists/event-artist-links.json) to exactly one real, already-ingested MEO Arena Observation. See docs/ARTIST_ENRICHMENT.md.

genres.basis: Evanescence's entire commercially released studio catalogue (Fallen, The Open Door, Evanescence, Synthesis, The Bitter Truth) has been consistently classified as alternative/gothic metal-rock across their whole touring career, not a one-off or recent rebrand — a stable, widely and consistently documented public genre identity, not derived from this Observation's own event listing text.

The same long-standing public discography is also routinely and consistently described as gothic metal alongside alternative metal; MODERATE (not HIGH) because the gothic-metal label is applied less uniformly across the catalogue than the alternative-metal one.

Jungle (the UK act) has been consistently described across their full studio catalogue (Jungle, For Ever, Loving in Stereo, Volcano) as an electronic/nu-disco and psychedelic-soul act built on production, groove and falsetto vocals rather than a rock band lineup — a stable public genre identity, not derived from this Observation's own event listing text.

aliases: DURAN DURAN - FREE TO LOVE TOUR

genres.basis: Duran Duran are one of the most widely and consistently documented 1980s New Wave/synth-pop acts, a genre identity that has followed their entire multi-decade touring career (including this 2026 tour) rather than being specific to one era or record.
The same New Wave identity is also routinely classified under Rock in addition to Pop; MODERATE because Pop is the more consistently primary classification across sources.

Amon Amarth are a long-established Swedish metal act whose entire studio catalogue and touring identity is consistently and uniformly documented as melodic death metal with Viking-themed lyrical/thematic content — a stable public genre identity, not derived from this Observation's own event listing text.

aliases: Thirty Seconds To Mars - Presents A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War

genres.basis: Thirty Seconds to Mars's studio catalogue (this tour explicitly references A Beautiful Lie and This Is War by name) has been consistently classified as alternative rock across their touring career — a stable public genre identity, not derived from this Observation's own event listing text.
The same identity is also commonly filed simply under the broader 'Alternative' family; MODERATE because 'Rock' is the more consistently primary classification.
